scope: Read-only local catalog/selected original role metadata and real descriptor/emit/consumer code. Shared contracts grouped to avoid33-by-platform matrix. No compile, run, GPU, acquisition/network or canonical changes. General loader/server/full-model execution is not used as a prerequisite for component support.

summary.not_claimed: A concrete reference consumer is not a source-bound complete artifact adapter. An original role component is not a whole-model result. Catalog artifact_execution_verified=false is not reused as a current blanket verdict; later original-role followups are reflected separately.

real_unclosed_connections.classification: SOURCE_MATH_OR_STORAGE_BINDING_UNKNOWN; not justified to implement by guessing
real_unclosed_connections.facts: Original ModelOpt expanded K/V QDQ config does not uniquely identify raw compact E4 scale or scaled DSA row layout. The current raw CKV512/576 consumer is explicitly independent. Assigning its scalar to these artifacts would invent semantics.
real_unclosed_connections.minimum_next: Resolve the already fixed source exporter/serving policy and actual scalar identity from cached metadata first. Keep the independent raw reader usable; do not silently reinterpret expanded K/V or demand a new cache owner.

real_unclosed_connections.classification: ARTIFACT_ROLE_ADAPTER_OR_SOURCE_CONTRACT_PARTIAL; not all equivalent to payload merely unrun
real_unclosed_connections.facts: Concrete readers/ordinary reference consumers are cited, but selected artifact-specific cold source-span/scale conversion/excluded-role or expert resource compositions are not all present. Exact unknowns are per-row. These are not33 new missing operators and not a request for a universal importer.
real_unclosed_connections.minimum_next: Choose one known source-role discontinuity, distinguish missing cold glue from missing source identity and missing numerical evidence, and implement only the actual glue needed by a finite original-role consumer. No full-artifact or platform matrix is a completion condition.

ct_int4.physical: I32 Q[N,K/8], original floating SF[N,K/g]; asymmetric Z[ceil(N/8),K/g] is separately N-packed. g32 Qwen, g128 Kimi.
ct_int4.arithmetic: Offset-binary low-first nibble. Decode product preserves declared scale/decode rounding. Qwen then uses BF16 operand/F32 accumulation/BF16 projection or F32 score; grouped Kimi reference has explicit BF16 decode then F32 A/Y. Not legacy AWQ GEMM packing.
ct_int4.actual_connection: Qwen preparer/roles -> CtPackedProjection -> actual Decode[/Cast]/transpose/MatMul. Existing flat expert reshape -> GroupedMatMul and closed-region packed contraction are concrete consumers.
ct_int4.limits: Actual Q27 asymmetric role is covered; catalog0 and Kimi22 exact payload/import coverage is partial. Odd-N independent expert Z fragments require the existing explicit zero-row repack, not concatenation. Packed/default policies differ by backend/rows; decomposition remains valid.

gptq_v1.arithmetic: Raw zero nibble+1 including15->16; g_idx selects original K scale group. Multiply rounds F16, explicit BF16 conversion before F32 dot; output BF16 projection/F32 scores.
gptq_v1.actual_connection: Prepared roles -> GptqProjection -> exact four-node Decode(F16)/Cast(BF16)/View/MatMul, plus actual original projection/target consumers.
gptq_v1.limits: Original Q35/Q27 finite consumers do not qualify all shards/whole models or arbitrary GPTQ dialects; desc_act/name is not a packing selector.

ct_channel_token.physical: Original E4 W[N,K] and BF16 SW[N,1]; input BF16 rows.
ct_channel_token.arithmetic: BF16 dynamic token absmax/448, exactly-zero scale epsilon, BF16 QDQ W and A, F32 accumulation and BF16 output. Different from F32 code-dot or block128.
ct_channel_token.actual_connection: Explicit CT policy -> roles -> ChannelTokenFp8Projection -> original ordinary Reduce/Select/Binary/Cast/MatMul graph. A reusable finite QDQ consumer also constructs this equation.
ct_channel_token.limits: Fixed CT BF16 software reader is explicit; no blanket native FP8 GEMM/deployment equivalence. Original Q27 source also has distinct local-NVFP4 roles.

modelopt_nvfp4.physical: Adjacent low-first U8 W[N,K/2], E4 SF[N,K/16], independent positive F32 WG/IG; selected-expert banks add E axis and checked I32 IDs.
modelopt_nvfp4.arithmetic: Group16 software A4 QDQ: original scale-first W and A operands stored BF16 before F32 dot, BF16 Y. WG/IG multiply semantics; not CT reciprocal/local arithmetic or hardware FP4 accumulation.
modelopt_nvfp4.actual_connection: Qwen prepared-role/typed binding emits Nvfp4Linear; the same original target fragment inserts seven actual calibrated projection leaves. GroupedNvfp4Linear is bound by the real WeightSlots selected-bank consumer.
modelopt_nvfp4.limits: A generic/actual Qwen original-role component is not an exact imported expert journey for all listed mixed publishers. Each original WG/IG and group must be authenticated; original payload absence is separate from an absent operation.

qwen_mlx_affine.physical: U32 continuous rows [N,(K/32)*bits], BF16 SF/bias[N,K/64], bits4 or8; source-sanitized direct norm gamma and conv[C,kernel,1].
qwen_mlx_affine.arithmetic: Linear/head F32 affine decode and dot, explicit output cast. Embedding keeps source BF16 multiply then BF16 add; tied payload does not make these two equations interchangeable.
qwen_mlx_affine.actual_connection: mlx_affine_roles -> normalized V2 physical identity -> prepared roles -> MlxAffineProjection/quantized embedding -> MlxQuantized. Original Q35 components and complete four text inventories are recorded.
qwen_mlx_affine.limits: This dense Qwen policy admits bits4/8 g64, not GLM mixed5/6 or arbitrary MLX transform flags. Component/source-resident evidence is not all original Q27 payload execution.

f32_block128_fp8.physical: Canonical encoded weight logically [K,N] (dense) or[E,N,K] (grouped), E4 codes plus F32 macroblock128 grid; source E4[N,K]/SF grid is cold imported, not reinterpreted.
f32_block128_fp8.arithmetic: F32 group128 activation scale with explicit Divide, PowerOfTwo or MultiplyReciprocal and floor; SATFINITE E4, F32 dot, output matches BF16/F32 A. Policy/floor are actual mathematical fields.
f32_block128_fp8.actual_connection: Qwen original BF16 scale grid is cold converted to the encoded carrier, then BlockFp8Projection emits Float8BlockLinear. Actual GLM MoE and grouped-power2/scale-policy consumers emit GroupedFloat8Linear and preserve store points.
f32_block128_fp8.limits: Qwen official uses Divide/floor1e-10; Kimi PB_WO selected software reader uses explicit dynamic128/floor1e-4 after F32 scale folding; DSpark uses PowerOfTwo/floor1e-4; GLM Quark override uses MultiplyReciprocal/floor1e-10. CUDA grouped PowerOfTwo accepts BF16, explicitly rejects F32. These are separate contracts, not all-math equivalence.

stored_static_fp8.arithmetic: F32(A)*F32(1/SA), SATFINITE E4, F32 code-dot, separate *SA then *SW, BF16 output. No extra BF16 intermediate and no scalar inversion of source identity.
stored_static_fp8.actual_connection: Qwen ModelOpt static policy/preparer/V2/typed binding emits the original twelve-node graph; StaticFloat8Pattern qualifies closed intermediates or retains decomposition. Real original k_proj CPU/CUDA component exists.
stored_static_fp8.limits: This is selected stored-scale software semantics, not fake-QDQ/native scaled_mm equivalence. Mixed Q27 header audit is85/208 with one actual original role; other mixed source/header/scalar bindings are not inferred from that result.

ct_local_nvfp4.limits: Q27 ordinary typed binding exists. Q24 fixed expert headers expose1593 groups only in the sampled header; exact selected-expert source-span import/remaining role census is not signed by the reference.

nf4_doublequant.physical: Six numeric operands: original U8 packed codes plus U8 absmax, F32 nested_absmax, F32 nested_map256, F32 map16 and original F32 offset. Bounded original quant_state authenticates shape/offset bits.
nf4_doublequant.arithmetic: Decode F16 and explicit F16 A/MatMul output, F32 accumulation. Dense source F16 norm/conv/embedding/head follow selected F16 precision; GDN recurrent state/declared accumulations remain F32.
nf4_doublequant.actual_connection: NF4 parser/preparer -> six prepared physical roles and per-group identity -> cold original loader -> Nf4Projection Decode(F16)/View/MatMul; existing closed packed contraction avoids whole weight expansion when selected.
nf4_doublequant.limits: All original per-group metadata and finite original-role components do not mean whole27B execution. Other BNB quant modes and BF16-by-default fallback are not admitted.

gguf_nvfp4_hybrid.physical: Per-tensor GGUF:374 NVFP4 type40,122 Q5_K,9 Q6_K,1 Q8_0,360 F32. NVFP4 is64 values/36B with four inline scales; not HF group16/global-scale NVFP4.
gguf_nvfp4_hybrid.arithmetic: F32 public activation/results through existing GGUF MatMul/GroupedMatMul/Gather, with original native internal quantization/reduction. Encoding/block math is not replaced by a dequantized HF FP4 equation.
gguf_nvfp4_hybrid.actual_connection: gguf_weight_description/gguf_grouped_weight_description(kNvfp4) -> concrete native Graph MatMul/grouped/Gather tests. Selected hybrid original header identifies embeddingQ6_K/headQ8_0, but that artifact has no source-bound full role consumer.
gguf_nvfp4_hybrid.limits: Original hybrid numeric payload is not acquired/executed in recorded scope. This is a missing artifact-level qualification/role adapter, not a proven missing shared block reader or need for a general loader.

quark_mxfp4_a4.arithmetic: Dynamic group32 even-scale/half-even A4; BF16 decoded W/A before F32 dot, BF16 Y. SF0=2^-127,255 invalid; zero/extreme portable policy explicit. No global scales or hardware FP4 equivalence.

micro32_mxfp4_a16.physical: Original U8 E2M1 W, F32 micro32 SF; cold positive-finite SF -> E8M0 codes0..254. Fixed mbs_mode=off has no extra macro/global operand.

important_distinctions: AWQ in a repository name does not select legacy AWQ packing.
CT BF16 channel/token or block128 QDQ cannot be replaced by F32 scale code-dot.
ModelOpt static stored SA/SW, local-dynamic CT NVFP4, ModelOpt NVFP4 and GGUF NVFP4 are independent equations/encodings.
MLX affine bits/orientation/source metadata dtype are explicit; Qwen dense4/8 does not silently cover GLM mixed5/6.
E8M0 stored grids, F32 stored grids and dynamic scale policies are independent facts.
CUDA grouped F32 PowerOfTwo remains explicitly rejected; this is a real backend qualification limit, not universal failure of the selected BF16 contract.
Neither33 source dispositions nor no new public primitive gap is an exhaustive feature-completion proof.

corrected_disposition.ordinary_sampled_roles: In the exact sampled ordinary layer0 header, all eight E8M0 grids are five attention and three shared-expert dense matrices. Routed experts are U8 NVFP4 with E4 group16 SF plus globals. Config ignores *.attn.* and *.ffn.shared_experts.* for the NVFP4 rule. A missing E8M0-to-grouped-FP8 expert path is therefore not established for25/26.
corrected_disposition.mtp_must_stay_distinct: Later exact MTP headers have I8 packed FP4/E8M0 group32 expert tiles as well as dense E4/E8M0 attention. They use GroupedFloat4Linear with dynamic A8, not ordinary NVFP4 experts or GroupedFloat8Linear. Do not merge the main-layer and MTP parameter/quantizer domains.
corrected_disposition.dense_connection: Already connected: exact original E4 row tiles and exact original E8M0 scales are loaded, scales losslessly widened to F32, import_float8_block128_weight produces the canonical encoded bank, then the actual BF16 Float8BlockLinear(PowerOfTwo,1e-4) Graph consumes that bank. The F32 comparison separately supplies already encoded A to MatMul and does not pretend CUDA dynamic-F32 power2 is supported.
corrected_disposition.full_ordinary_role_limit: The cached authenticated tiles are mtp.0.attn.wkv first3 rows/fullK, not complete ordinary layer0 tensors. Their original source identity/reader connection is valid finite projection evidence; it is not ordinary full-layer/model/state or quality evidence. No byte identity with an ordinary layer0 role is assumed.
corrected_disposition.next_action: No new grouped consumer, codec or download is warranted by the withdrawn inference. Existing cached original tiles suffice to reproduce the already executed dense projection/importer check if a future relevant change requires it; this review requests no rerun.

cache_binding_decision.decision: Retain both explicit boundaries. Weight codec and a generic FP8 kv_cache_scheme do not select one physical compact cache representation or uniquely supply its scale. Do not bind an expanded-K/V source scalar to raw CKV, guess unit scale from another recipe, or reinterpret it as mixed scaled-DSA656/528. An artifact-specific consumer must select its declared reader and authenticate the corresponding physical operands; the current library already accepts explicit compact storage parameters.

This is not resolved by the independent raw compact reader, and no full-artifact support claim is made. cache_binding_decision.implementation: No new default, operation, cache owner, conversion or executor justified by this source mismatch. Existing expanded math primitives and independent compact MLA capability remain separate contracts.
cache_binding_decision.limits: Source inspection only; no new model acquisition, source lookup, numerical run, native GPU, quality or performance measurement. Existing compact MLA numerical/backend evidence remains limited to its original scope.
